description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans streaming system, specifically testing client behavior with the MemoryStreamProvider. It sets up a test cluster with in-memory stream providers, and includes tests for client disconnection scenarios affecting stream producers and consumers.

classes.name: MemoryStreamProviderClientTests
classes.description: Contains setup for testing Orleans client behavior with MemoryStreamProvider, including configuration fixtures and test methods for producer and consumer disconnection scenarios.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture that configures an Orleans cluster with in-memory stream provider and storage for testing purposes.

methods.name: MemoryStreamProviderClientTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test runner with the configured cluster.

methods.name: MemoryStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method verifying that stream production stops and cleans up properly when a client disconnects.

methods.name: MemoryStreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method verifying proper cleanup and message handling when a consumer client disconnects.
